manifest_issues.title: Debuggable Build
manifest_issues.description: android:debuggable=true — allows arbitrary code execution via adb on any device.

manifest_issues.title: Backup Enabled
manifest_issues.description: android:allowBackup=true — app data can be extracted via adb backup without root.

manifest_issues.title: Cleartext Traffic Permitted
manifest_issues.description: android:usesCleartextTraffic=true — HTTP connections allowed, MITM trivial.

manifest_issues.title: Exported Activity Without Permission
manifest_issues.description: Exported activity accessible to any app without permission check.

manifest_issues.title: Low minSdkVersion (21)
manifest_issues.description: Targets Android 5.0+ — exposes app to known pre-Nougat vulnerabilities.

manifest_issues.title: StrandHogg Task Hijacking
manifest_issues.description: singleTask + targetSdk < 28 — vulnerable to UI overlay task hijacking.

threats.title: SMS Harvester
threats.description: SmsManager.sendTextMessage — outbound SMS exfiltration detected in dex bytecode

threats.title: Dynamic Code Loading
threats.description: DexClassLoader instantiation — loads external DEX/APK at runtime, dropper behaviour

threats.title: Native Library Execution
threats.description: System.loadLibrary with obfuscated name — possible native payload side-load

threats.title: Reflection-Based Invocation
threats.description: java.lang.reflect.Method.invoke — used to obscure API calls from static analysis

threats.title: Device ID Collection
threats.description: TelephonyManager.getDeviceId / getImei — harvesting persistent device identifiers

threats.title: HTTP Plaintext Connection
threats.description: HttpURLConnection without TLS — credentials and data sent in cleartext

defences.title: Root Detection Present
defences.description: Checks for su binary and Magisk paths — app attempts to detect analysis environment
